overview.text: Public discussion of Fixture Towers mostly concerns possession timing. The registry lists a completion date of 31 December 2027.

considerations.text: Several buyers report that possession was delayed.
considerations.caveat: Reported in public posts; not confirmed by the developer.

reviews.text: I booked a 3 BHK here in 2024. The sample flat matched the brochure, but possession was delayed by six months.

Possession has been delayed a little.
